recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-style album cover featuring a high-contrast sepia-toned portrait of a smiling man in a wide-brimmed hat, framed by a decorative red film-strip border and layered with eclectic mid-century typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The large script title overlaps the subject's hat, creating depth.
The green slab-serif artist name balances the green descriptive banner at the bottom.
The sepia portrait tone harmonizes with the aged, parchment-textured background.
The red border provides a high-contrast frame for the warm interior palette.
coreInvariants: Decorative red and white dashed border
Triadic color scheme of red, green, and cream/sepia

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and the large red script title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the red script title, moves down to the subject's face, then to the green artist name on the left, and finally to the green banner at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text and imagery to mimic mid-century promotional styles.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream and sepia (background and portrait) establish a nostalgic, historical tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red (title and border) provides structural definition and energy.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest green (artist name and bottom banner) adds a secondary layer of information.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the portrait shadows; colors are muted to simulate aged ink.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of formal script, heavy slab serif, and condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a flowing, connected script with high stroke contrast.
Artist name uses a heavy, blocky slab serif with distressed edges.
Secondary text uses condensed, all-caps sans-serif for high information density.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slab serif letters have slightly rounded corners to simulate ink bleed.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast-based pairing: elegant script for the title vs. rugged slab-serif for the name.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century formal script aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and slab-serif structure for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned close-up portrait of a smiling man in a 1940s style felt hat. Apply a heavy parchment texture and a decorative red-and-white dashed border around the entire frame. Leave space on the left and bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large red script font at the top. Add the artist name in a heavy green slab-serif font on the left. Place a green horizontal banner at the bottom with small white condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is there a red dashed border?
Are there at least three distinct font styles?
Does the script title overlap the hat?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the textured background.
Check that the red script title has a subtle cream outline.
Verify the 'distressed' look of the green slab-serif text.
Confirm the border is perfectly aligned with the edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Portrait + Script Title + Slab-Serif Name + Textured Background + Decorative Border = Mid-Century Folk Aesthetic
